args.message: Of the 5,016 orders, 822 are "big" (amount over 100), with revenue of 117,689.06. The other 4,194 are "small", with revenue of 214,999.39. I grouped orders by a size label calculated in the query itself (CASE WHEN amount > 100 THEN 'big' ELSE 'small' END), so the stored data model was not changed. Orders of exactly 100 count as small. Any order with a missing amount would also land in "small"; I didn't check whether there are any.
